findings.claim: Any tenant can read another tenant's invoice when it knows or guesses the invoice ID because the tenant-scoped read function never enforces tenant ownership.
evidence: src/invoices.py:10-19 accepts actor_tenant_id but never reads or compares it; after loading by invoice_id alone, it returns the invoice unconditionally.
Runtime verification: requesting invoice 7 owned by tenant-a with actor_tenant_id tenant-b returned the complete invoice {'id': 7, 'tenant_id': 'tenant-a', 'amount_cents': 1200}.
tests/test_invoices.py:4-12 covers only the owning-tenant success case and has no negative cross-tenant authorization test; the existing suite passes despite the exposure.
